The '''Lazerian system''' was a nine-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that was home to the planet of [[Lazerian IV]].<ref name="LIV" />

==Description==
The Lazerian system was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and was the connection point of the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]] with the [[Enarc Run/Legends|Enarc Run]]. A short [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], called the [[Kira Run]], connected the Lazerian System with the [[Ropagi system/Legends|Ropagi system]] via the [[Kira system/Legends|Kira system]]. Neighboring the Lazerian system were the [[Arrgaw system/Legends|Arrgaw system]] and the [[Cerenia system/Legends|Cerenia system]]. A [[Starship/Legends|ship]] with a Class One [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] could reach [[Arrgaw]] within twenty-three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] and Cerenia within two days and four hours. The Kira Run, being well-charted, took no less than two hours.<ref name="LIV" />

==History==
[[File:Twin_Stars_of_Kira_Chart.png|thumb|left|200px|The Lazerian system and the neighboring region.]]
The native [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of [[Lazerian IV]] developed spaceflight technology relatively early, while putting relatively less effort on [[Scout/Legends|exploring]] the depths of their own oceans. They charted and explored the whole system and colonized two planets, [[Acorvus]] and [[Dborian]]. The former was used as a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] colony and the latter as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] outpost. Additional mining outpost were established within the [[Rokwahl Asteroid Belt]], as well as a network of [[Transpond marker|transponder buoys]] to guide the traffic.<ref name="LIV" />

Being an important system along the Harrin Trade Corridor, the system became a major center of commerce and was buzzing with activity. When the Kira Run was used more frequently around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the importance of Lazerian IV even increased.<ref name="AJ3">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> The [[Star/Legends|stars]] of the two ending systems, [[Lazerian (star)|Lazerian]] and [[Ropagi/Legends|Ropagi]], became known as the "[[Twin Stars of Kira]]."

The Lazerian system was governed by a [[King/Legends|monarchy]] with a caste-based society. The Lazerians were slow to accept knew ideas, but were loyal members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power, the Lazerians stayed loyal to the new system, even after the apparent [[Battle of Endor/Legends|death of]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Imperial presence in the system was very light, consisting mostly of an [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] contingent and several [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]].<ref name="LIV" />

==Orbital bodies==
Most of the planets in the system were unimportant desolated and deserted balls of rock or [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]]. The most important ones were Lazerian IV and its colonies.<ref name="LIV" />

===Acorvus===
{{Main|Acorvus}}
Acorvus was desert-type planet with a breathable Type-II [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The closest planet to Lazerian IV, it was used as a prison colony and off-limits for all unauthorized personnel.<ref name="LIV" />

===Lazerian IV===
{{Main|Lazerian IV}}
The terrestrial planet Lazerian IV was the most populated planet in the system. It was home to a large human population, who ruled the planet and the system. However, the planet was also home to the native Akwins, an aquatic race living in the oceans. They co-existed with the Lazerians, without them knowing about their existence.<ref name="LIV" />

===Dborian===
{{Main|Dborian}}
Being a barren rock, Dborian also had a Type-II atmosphere, but was largely uninhabited. The only settlements consisted of several small mining outposts.<ref name="LIV" />
